ai.title: Parallel score test execution and subtest context
ai.summary: Refactored `projectTest` in `score-tests.ts` to accept a `getContext` factory, enabling parallel execution of subtests via `Promise.all`. `manifold-project.test.ts` now runs `testDeleteComment` 3 times concurrently using `lodash.range`. The scoring logic tracks aggregate scores and per-subtest scores in `subScores`, printing detailed breakdowns to console. This internal change improves test throughput and observability without affecting production code.

eli5.text: The internal test system can now run the same check three times all at once instead of one after another, which makes the suite that guards the Manifold project finish faster. You won't see any button or new feature from this, it only touches automated checks behind the scenes. If you were watching those checks, they'd now print each sub-test's separate pass or fail tally alongside the total score, so it's easier to spot which part broke when something fails.

ai.title: Add 60s timeout to OpenAI API requests
ai.summary: backend/src/openai-api.ts adds timeoutPromise(60000) and wraps openai.chat.completions.create in Promise.race for promptOpenAI and promptOpenAIWithContinuation. Prevents indefinite hangs on upstream OpenAI API latency or stalls. Backend only; affects both non-streaming and streaming chat completions paths.

eli5.text: When you send a question to the backend, it waits up to 60 seconds for a response from the AI service. If the response doesn't arrive in time, it stops waiting and shows an error instead of hanging forever. This affects all requests made after today, ensuring you never get stuck on a stalled conversation.

ai.title: Add manifold project test without knowledge context
ai.summary: Added testDeleteCommentWithoutKnowledge to verify code generation accuracy when fileContext.knowledgeFiles is empty. Test asserts presence of delete-comment.ts, app.ts, and schema.ts changes, then scores based on yarn compile type errors. Also silenced stdout chunk writing in runMainPrompt.

eli5.text: The test suite now runs the assistant once more, this time pretending it has no stored knowledge files to reference, to make sure generated code still stays correct and compiles cleanly. If you peek at the logs you'll see an extra pass labeled 'test delete comment without knowledge' alongside the old one, and a small scoring step that counts type errors from the build. Internally this just silences noisy output and adds that second test run; nothing in the live product behaves differently today.

ai.title: Manifold mock project build fix
ai.summary: Removed `incremental` flag from `tsconfig.json` in `backend/api` and `backend/shared` mock projects. Added `declarationMap` to `backend/shared`. Fixes manifold project build.

eli5.text: The testing setup for one part of the app was fixed so that internal code checks run correctly. Engineers working on that section will now see the tests start passing where they previously failed. The fix adjusts how the test environment builds a small practice version of the code, removing a speed-up option that was causing problems and adding better tracking of type names. The change is live now for anyone running these specific tests.
